name: Visualizer pack
author: Voltage
description: Three more progress-bar animations in the song's colours: Particles, Ribbon and Pixel blocks. Pick one in Settings > Appearance > Progress animation.

waveStyles.label: Particles
waveStyles.help: Sparks drift off the playhead and fade along the played part.

waveStyles.label: Ribbon
waveStyles.help: Three soft, overlapping colour ribbons flowing up to the playhead.

waveStyles.label: Pixel blocks
waveStyles.help: A retro, stepped block meter in the song's colour.
